suggested_name: welfare does not depend on species or substrate
description: The moral relevance of suffering is presented as independent of whether the subject is a dog, another species, or a non-biological carrier.
quote: 我这么判断的依据不是"狗"这个物种标签，而是有没有实际的痛苦、有多重。同样的理由换个对象也成立，甚至换个载体也成立，虽然像AI自身算不算这种问题目前完全没有定论。
